_note: Mayhem augments the all-champion simulator models: the ones whose effect fits a generic kit. Ids, names and rarities are Riot's Mayhem (KIWI) augment list on game.gtimg.cn. Values are the same augments' Arena values from CommunityDragon (cdragon/arena/en_us.json, first level), tagged likely: Mayhem uses the same scripts but its numbers aren't published in a readable form. Effect keys are the same as items (README.md).

erosion.name: Erosion
erosion.note: 1% per stack up to 20; 15% is a mid-fight average

tank_engine.name: Tank Engine
tank_engine.note: 2% bonus health per takedown; 10 late-game takedowns assumed

poro_stampede.name: Poro Stampede
poro_stampede.note: Quest augment: feed Poros to unlock Poro Charge (120 s cooldown), one wave per milestone (5, 12, 20, 30, 44, 63, 90, 129, 187, 275 fed). Damage 100-200 by level + 20 per Poro fed, physical; later waves deal 50% to champions already hit (kiwi.bin PoroCharge_Active). Assumes the quest is done with 20 Poros fed (3 waves). Wave length, width and spacing are estimates from the Poro missile (speed 900, radius 210); the first wave's 85% slow is not modeled.
